visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair wearing a white t-shirt and black pants sits on a light grey sofa. She holds a large, ornate purple box featuring branding for vivo and POP MART. The setting is a clean, modern living room with soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) She begins the unboxing process, revealing the interior of the purple box which contains a black smartphone box and several smaller purple accessory boxes. She moves closer to the camera to show the contents in detail. (3) The woman holds up a deep purple vivo V60 smartphone, showcasing its sleek design and triple-camera setup on the back. She then displays the front of the phone, showing a custom ZSIGA-themed wallpaper. (4) The camera focuses on the phone screen as she demonstrates an interactive camera feature. Various cute character accessories like stickers, a textured phone pouch, and a lanyard are shown individually. (5) She opens a second, larger box decorated with sky and flower illustrations. This box contains 12 blind boxes. (6) The final phase shows all 12 ZSIGA figures displayed on a tiered stand. She points to specific figures, demonstrating their magnetic accessories and various surface textures such as smooth and patterned finishes.

(4) [Logo]: vivo V60, POP MART, ZSIGA. (5) [Subtitle]: V60手機在這裡. (6) [Subtitle]: 它的桌布超可愛的誒. (7) [Subtitle]: 還有一個手機掛繩. (8) [Subtitle]: 總共有12盒. (9) [Variety]: 叮咚!!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, high-pitched female voice introduces the unboxing over a bright, acoustic guitar-driven pop BGM. The tempo is upbeat and the tone is welcoming. (2) Subtle mechanical clicks and soft thuds are heard as she handles the large gift box. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythm. (3) A 'ding' sound effect punctuates the reveal of the smartphone. Her vocal energy increases, showing excitement through rising intonation. (4) More rustling of plastic packaging and paper occurs as accessories are showcased. The audio mix keeps the voice clearly above the ambient room tone and incidental noises. (5) A whoosh transition effect accompanies a change in scene. The female narrator continues explaining the features, joined briefly by a male voice who adds complementary comments at the end of the video.
